blocks.html:
Welcome to our section dedicated to digital tools for teaching, studying, and planning your daily work!

Here you will find a selection of platforms and applications that can help you improve your productivity, organize your work, and make learning more effective. Explore the collection and discover the tools that best suit your needs.

eLab is at your disposal to provide support on the use of digital tools and to explore together the best ways to integrate them into your teaching and/or daily activities.

For support or advice on using the tools, please contact us via the USI service portal.

items.title: iCorsi
items.html:
iCorsi is the USI eLearning platform, based on Moodle (version 4.3 - updated on January 21, 2025). iCorsi allows teachers and students to manage, share, and consult teaching materials, carry out interactive activities, and check assignments for plagiarism using Turnitin software.

New: Starting in the 2024-2025 academic year, online exams will no longer be held in iCorsi, but on the dedicated platform: Exam.iCorsi.

Interactivity and inclusion in iCorsi

To promote active learning, iCorsi has advanced interactive plugins such as:

  • H5P - for creating quizzes and multimedia content
  • Board - for visual collaboration and brainstorming
  • Amanote - for taking notes directly on course material

These plugins make the learning experience more dynamic, engaging, and personalized!

The platform can be accessed with your edu-ID credentials.
To access the platform: https://www.icorsi.ch
Further information about iCorsi can be found in our FAQ: https://faq.icorsi.ch/?lang=en

items.title: Microsoft Teams
items.html:
Microsoft Teams is the tool recommended by USI for live streaming your online lessons.

MS Teams allows you to share your screen or presentation with students, interact with them during the lesson, temporarily divide them into different groups for group work or discussions, record the online lesson, etc.

MS Teams is also used for online oral exams.

To access MS Teams, you need to download the app from USI Cloud and use your USI CAMPUS credentials.
For questions about MS Teams: https://faq.icorsi.ch/tag/teams

items.title: Turnitin
items.html:
Turnitin is software that allows you to check for plagiarism: in just a few clicks, Turnitin lets you know if a text or part of a text has been copied from the internet or from another text available online.

Turnitin is available to all USI and SUPSI lecturers and assistants via the iCorsi platform.
Further information on Turnitin can be found in our FAQs: https://faq.icorsi.ch/tag/turnitin?lang=en.

items.title: ePortfolio
items.html:
Nella didattica, un portafoglio elettronico (e-Portfolio) è una raccolta ragionata dei lavori degli studenti, di documenti digitali che mostrano la progressione dell'apprendimento degli studenti, i risultati e le prove di ciò che gli studenti sono in grado di fare.

L'e-Portfolio permette agli studenti di raccogliere, creare, organizzare, condividere e pubblicare online documenti di diverso tipo, favorendo la loro pratica riflessiva su quello che imparano nei corsi.

eLab ha creato una piattaforma di e-Portfolio per USI e SUPSI utilizando il software open-source Mahara
https://eportfolio.elearninglab.org/.
Per accedere alla piattaforma occorre autenticarsi con le proprie credenziali edu-ID.

items.title: Mindmeister
items.html:
Mindmeister allows you to create, manage and share online mindmaps by collaborating in real time with your students or colleagues.

To obtain a Mindmeister Edu Campus licence, simply create an account on www.mindmeister.com using your @usi.ch or @supsi.ch e-mail address.
For further information: https://faq.icorsi.ch/tag/mindmeister?lang=en.

items.title: Wooclap
items.html:
Wooclap is an online platform that allows you to interact with your students or your audience through different types of events and activities (questionnaires, polls, closed or open-ended questions, etc.), thus keeping students active and participating during the lesson.

All members of the USI community can access Wooclap via the web or through iCorsi or use it integrated in PowerPoint presentations.

For more information: https://faq.icorsi.ch/tag/wooclap?lang=en

items.title: Wooflash
items.html:
Wooflash is an intelligent microlearning platform designed based on neuroscience and adaptive learning to significantly optimize learning quality. With Wooflash, students can follow personalized study and revision paths tailored to their specific needs. This tool provides additional support for your students as they prepare for exams!

Features

  • Diversified revision methods (flashcards, MCQs, etc.)
  • Personalized learning path
  • Tool based on neuroeducational principles (active learning, immediate feedback, long-term memory reinforcement)
  • Track your learning progress
  • AI integration to create quizzes faster using the course material
  • Collaboration and sharing between students

All members of the USI community can access Wooflash via the web (Microsoft credentials).
For more information: Wooflash FAQs

items.title: Panopto
items.html:
Panopto is software that allows you to record video lessons by combining the video of the teacher with a recording of their screen or PowerPoint presentation.

Panopto can also be used to record your own lessons on campus, in classrooms where it is installed, and to save and share videos recorded with other software.

Log in to Panopto using your USI CAMPUS account.
For questions about Panopto: https://faq.icorsi.ch/tag/panopto
For those who wish to record their video lessons at USI, room 408 (main building of the West Campus, Lugano) is available and can be booked by sending an email to helpdesk@elearninglab.org.

items.title: Prezi
items.html:
Prezi is a tool for creating presentations, videos and infographics.

As a presentation tool, Prezi can be an interesting alternative to PowerPoint: by using a canvas in which you can zoom in and out on different elements, Prezi allows you to keep the overall picture of the presentation in focus.

eLab has purchased some Edu licenses of Prezi; if you would like to have one, please ask Stefano Tardini.

items.title: Teaching.Tools
items.html:
Teaching Tools is a platform designed to support teachers in creating engaging lessons and diversifying their teaching activities.

The platform offers three main features:

  • Plan a Lesson: an intuitive Lesson Builder that helps you formulate learning objectives and develop a lesson plan (from scratch or using templates).
  • Brainstorming with AI: a beta tool that uses artificial intelligence to generate concrete ideas for making lessons more interactive.
  • Find an Activity: a collection of teaching activities tailored to your class.

Teaching.Tools also offers a collection of bibliographic suggestions related to teaching.

You can access the site for free by creating a personal account.

items.title: MyPLE
items.html:
MyPLE is an open source online platform developed by the University of Fribourg in collaboration with USI, which provides over 110 digital tools, most of which are accessible free of charge. Each tool is accompanied by a detailed description of its features and possible uses.

The aim of MyPLE is to support students, teachers, and staff in choosing and using the digital resources best suited to their needs. In addition, the platform offers online training activities dedicated to enhancing digital skills.

The site is available in Italian, French, and German.

To access the site: https://myple.unifr.ch/it

items.title: Microsoft Loop
items.html:
Microsoft Loop is an online collaboration platform developed by Microsoft, designed to facilitate teamwork through shareable and real-time synchronized components. This application allows users to create and manage content in a collaborative manner, offering greater flexibility and integration with other Microsoft tools.

Key components of Microsoft Loop:

  • Workspaces: places where team members can organize and group information related to specific projects.
  • Pages: flexible surfaces within workspaces where you can insert and organize various types of content.
  • Components: modular elements that can be inserted into pages and shared across different Microsoft 365 applications, such as Teams, Outlook, and Word.

To access the platform: https://loop.cloud.microsoft/
